rules.statement: The Court can only exercise its powers to modify charitable trusts under section 100 of the Trusts Ordinance to carry out the intentions of the founders, provided those intentions are not inconsistent with existing laws.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is not its duty to direct charity property to be employed in such manner as it thinks will be the most beneficial for public purposes, but to carry into effect the intentions expressed by the founders, so far as those intentions are not inconsistent with any existing law."
